title: Isbahaysiga Soo Jeediyay Burburka
intro: Bal qiyaas inaad ku gabbato isla saqafkii muujinta, haddana aad doorato daacadnimo ka duwan. Qofkani wuxuu si dhow ugu noolaa runta iyo nebinimada, laakiin wuxuu u jeestay kuwii diiday. Sheekadoodu waxay u taagan tahay digniin adag oo ah in u dhowaanshaha xaqnimada oo keliya aysan badbaadin karin naf khiyaamaysa kalsoonida.
clues: Waxaan ku noolaa guriga nebi uu Alle doortay.
Waan ogaa runta uu ninkaygu wacdiyey, haddana si dhab ah uma aanan rumaysan.
Waan khiyaamay kalsoonidiisa anigoo garab istaagay dadkiisa diidaya oo ka caawinaya isaga.
Waxaa laygu xusay xaas kale oo nebi ah oo iyaduna khiyaamaysay, tusaale ahaan gaalada.
Sheekadayda waxaa lagu sheegay Suurada At-Tahrim iyadoo ah digniin ah in qaraabonimada nebiyada aysan ilaalinayn.
Waxaan la halligmay daalimiintii markii Eebe halaagay qoomkii Luudh, waxaana ka tagay kuwii harsanaa.

identity.label: Kumaan ahay?
options: Xaaskii Nabi Luut

trial.label: Tijaabo/Dhacdo
options: Nabiga ayuu khiyaameeyay isagoo ka caawinaya gaalada isaga.
Ilmo yar ku tuur wabiga dambiil si uu u badbaadiyo
Ma la dalbaday in dibi dahab ah la dhiso intii uu nebigu maqnaa?
Wasiir xaq ah oo ku eedeeyay inuu sameeyay khaladaad, xabsigana dhigay
Hoggaaminayay ciidan maroodi ah si ay u burburiyaan Kacbada
trial.answer: Nabiga ayuu khiyaameeyay isagoo ka caawinaya gaalada isaga.

location.answer: Magaalooyinka la rogay ee dadkii Luut

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Waxay la halaagtay gaalada iyadoo guursatay nebi
Waxaa la badbaadiyay mu'miniinta, waxaana Jannada lagu galay nabad.
Waxaa loo beddelay tiir calaamad u ah jiilalka dambe

outcome.answer: Waxay la halaagtay gaalada iyadoo guursatay nebi

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
